name: Tropicana Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，Tropicana Corporation Berhad 通过全资子公司 Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd 提出两项土地收购，分别以 RM151,060,000 收购约 21.03 英亩的 14 幅土地，以及以 RM44,820,000 收购约 3.12 英亩的一幅土地，均属关联方交易。此外，公司于年内发布多项财务资助公告及季度业绩。
overview_en: In 2026, Tropicana Corporation Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd, proposed two land acquisitions: 14 parcels of land measuring approximately 21.03 acres for RM151,060,000 and a parcel of land measuring approximately 3.12 acres for RM44,820,000, both related party transactions. The company also issued several financial assistance announcements and quarterly results during the year.

segments.name: 房地产发展与物业管理
segments.note: 今年通过子公司提出两项土地收购，以扩大土地储备。
segments.note_en: This year, the company proposed two land acquisitions through its subsidiary to expand its land bank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd 与 Maya Elemen Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 RM151,060,000 收购约 21.03 英亩的 14 幅永久及租赁地契土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Maya Elemen Sdn Bhd to acquire 14 parcels of freehold and leasehold land measuring approximately 21.03 acres for RM151,060,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd 与 Tanjung Mali Resort Development Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 RM44,820,000 收购一幅约 3.12 英亩的租赁地契土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Tropicana Scenic Development Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Tanjung Mali Resort Development Sdn Bhd to acquire a parcel of leasehold land measuring approximately 3.12 acres for RM44,820,000.
